title: Batman and the Outsiders #23 DC 1985 Truth About Halo Pt 4 Alan Davis Mike Barr
condition_description: Bright cover with light handling wear and light toning on the back cover. See photos.
description:
Batman and the Outsiders #23 (July 1985), DC Comics - "The Truth About Halo, Part 4: The Search for Halo." Written by Mike W. Barr, cover and art by Alan Davis. With Halo, Batman, Geo-Force, Katana, Black Lightning and Metamorpho. DC 50th anniversary cover logo. 75 cent cover price.

Back cover: Kenner Super Powers Collection action figure ad.

Condition: bright cover with light handling wear; light toning on the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
